interpretation.combination_rule: PASS (measurement_valid) = ANY arm's precondition gate is green -- aggregate_arm_gates' any-arm-green, NEVER all-arms-green. A red arm does NOT vacate a green one (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-785). Each arm's gate is the conjunction of the preconditions that APPLY to it; z_goal_nondegenerate_every_seed and z_goal_dose_separation apply to 'g4_seeded' only and are scoped out of 'g1_emergent' (see their applies_note). As in V3-EXQ-932 this gates MEASUREMENT VALIDITY, not coupling detection: whether any coupling clears the |r|/|rho| floor is REPORTED, never gated. UNLIKE V3-EXQ-932, a coupling is only reported at all once it is 'settled' (n + affect-channel variance + DV base rate); otherwise r/rho are null, so an emitted 0.0 now means a measured zero.

scoped_out.name: g1_emergent::z_goal_nondegenerate_every_seed
scoped_out.reason: SCOPED OUT of ARM_G1_EMERGENT deliberately. That arm's entire purpose is to MEASURE whether z_goal forms at V3-EXQ-932's own operating point (gain 1.0); requiring it to form there would make the arm structurally un-passable and collapse the two-arm design back to one -- the V3-EXQ-785 defect. A flat z_goal in the emergent arm is this run's RESULT, and the per-coupling admissibility gate reports it as unsettable_x_degenerate rather than as a near-null coupling.

interpretation.approach_dv_disposition: DROPPED FROM THE GATING SET, with evidence. Both mode-based approach couplings are gating:false (retained verbatim for 906c/932 comparability, REPORTED-ONLY). The precedence-free variant `approach_raw` (harm_signal > 0.01) is measured alongside so the drop rests on the event's own base rate rather than on _classify_mode's affect precedence. A direct probe of this env config (2026-08-19, seed 0, 66 steps) found harm_signal > 0.01 on 1/66 steps (1.5%), below MIN_DV_BASE_RATE, so `approach` is expected unsettable in the reef regime at ANY precedence. Re-tuning ENV_KWARGS to make it fire was REJECTED: it would change the substrate under study and break comparability on every other coupling.
interpretation.note: OBSERVATIONAL / DIAGNOSTIC -- promotes nothing, weights no governance (claim_ids=[], experiment_purpose=diagnostic). Lettered re-instrument of V3-EXQ-932 per failure_autopsy_931-932-wanting-authority-cluster_2026-08-16 Section 8. 932's MEASUREMENT-VALIDITY PASS stands and is NOT superseded; what is repaired is its reported, non-gating coupling narrative. A lagged correlation is consistent with but does NOT establish that the signal DRIVES behaviour; the partial correlations reduce ONE confound (a shared z_goal driver), they do not make the design causal. The causal-necessity test is the separate ablation V3-EXQ-931.

evidence_direction_note: Governance 2026-08-21 gov-20260821-0203 ratified failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-932a_2026-08-20.json: V3-EXQ-932a is claim-free (claim_ids []), diagnostic-purpose, promotes nothing and weights no governance; no claim-layer disposition is owed and none is offered. Its GOV-FAILLOC-1 exposure -- a claim-free run's prose making an organism-level competence assertion with no claims.yaml gate in front of it -- is ABSENT: the driver contains exactly one organism-level mention and it is a question, the manifest note independently disclaims causal inference, and the predecessor cluster's standing prohibition against paraphrasing any of this as 'wanting does not work in REE' is respected. Two findings bound how the run should be read. (1) Its label is carried by the NON-PRODUCTION arm: z_goal_seeding_gain ships at 1.0, and in that arm NO wanting coupling clears the 0.15 floor on r -- the only one flagged nontrivial qualifies on |rho| and is NEGATIVE (r -0.132, rho -0.219), opposite to the incentive-salience reading the label evokes, with a within-seed pooled r of +0.541, opposite again. All positive floor-clearing couplings live in the gain-4.0 arm. The label logic is an any() across BOTH arms, sign-agnostic, and ungated (the PASS would be identical had every coupling come back trivial). This is a FIFTH instance of the pattern the 2026-08-16 human gate flagged as CROSS-CLUSTER decision 4 and should be routed to that already-authorised warn-only lint. (2) The production arm does NOT reproduce the predecessor autopsy's sole surviving finding: wanting -> moved pooled r fell +0.373 -> +0.081 and its partial on z_goal +0.432 -> +0.070, from 3/3 seeds replicated to 2/3 settled, and it no longer clears the floor. That comparison is CONFOUNDED and cannot be attributed to instrument repair: the queue note calls g1_emergent 'byte-identical' to 932's operating point, which is true of the knob and false of the substrate -- substrate_commit moved c38e083d -> 196869ee, total_eval_steps fell 1013 -> 753 (-26%) at identical env settings, and z_goal liveness moved from seed 2 at active_frac 0.0087 to seed 0 at 0.4691. 932's measurement-validity PASS stands and is NOT superseded; what is in doubt is the coupling narrative at the production operating point, and this run cannot settle it.
